title: Ben & Lynn's Grand Opening
description: Ben & Lynn's by chef Joshua Weissman opens on the east side on Saturday, September 12, featuring fried chicken sandwiches, soft serve, local beers, and more.

title: Pecan Street Festival
description: Pecan Street Festival returns with live music, local artists, food vendors, and family fun at Hill Country Galleria.

title: San Marcos Block Party
description: A Labor Day Weekend celebration of music and art featuring performances from Tape B, Juicy J, Waka Flocka, art installations, experiential activations, and food vendors.

title: Robert Earl Keen at Longhorn City Limits
description: Free concert featuring Robert Earl Keen and Shinyribs at Longhorn City Limits with $5 beers, Tito's cocktails, and Pinkerton's BBQ.

description: Sweat for Shelter Pets benefits Austin Pets Alive! with fitness challenges, adoptable pets, vendors, coffee, mimosas, and fun for all levels.

title: Free Cheeseburgers at Hat Creek Burgers

description: Athletes First Tailgate Tour at Victory Lap featuring a live podcast taping with Vince Young and Mack Brown, plus special guests Jamaal Charles and Colt McCoy. 18+ to attend.

description: Watch the Texas Football game at Inn Cahoots featuring free hot dogs and giveaways, food vendors, drink specials, lawn games, and live music throughout the day.

title: Juntos Festival

title: News Reading Club
description: Tomo Mags and The Trust Project are launching the News Reading Club at Thompson Austin, bringing people together for real-life conversations around reliable news reporting.

title: Dear Media Studio Event
description: Join Dear Media Studio in Austin for candid conversations with founders, entrepreneurs, and creators offering actionable advice for your career and life.

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...
description: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015 This happens to be our 9,000th post (hell ya) From our founder @champagnecates: Our first post ever was SLAB BBQ’s 1 year anniversary with $1 drinks and $1 sandwiches. After 11 years I can honestly say that WWW has the same heart, same ethos, same community-driven mentality from day one. I set out to change the way event-goer and event were connected. I wanted to combine my writing background and my partying background to deliver plans and news in a minimal and personable new way. I feel like we really did all that.
